label: Enable remote access
help: Off by default. While off, no request reaches Microsoft and the wallet is never read.

label: OAuth grant secret
help: Wallet reference holding JSON with client_id and refresh_token (plus client_secret for a confidential app), or an access token. Never the token itself.

label: Tenant
help: Directory used for the token request: common, organizations, consumers, a tenant ID or a domain such as contoso.com.

label: Default operation
help: Used when a request gives no operation. Changes need Allow writes; sends also need Allow sending.

label: Operations a request may choose
help: JSON array of operation names, for example ["mail_list", "mail_get", "files_list"]. The default operation is always allowed.

label: Mail folder
help: Folder listed by default and watched for new mail: inbox, archive, sentitems, drafts, deleteditems, junkemail or a folder ID.

label: Calendar ID
help: Empty uses the default calendar. Otherwise the ID of another calendar of the account.

label: OneDrive folder
help: OneDrive path listed by default; uploads and new folders always stay inside it. Empty is the drive root.

label: Allow writes
help: Off by default. Required to send, move or mark mail, change events, upload files, create folders and post to Teams.

label: Allow sending
help: Required for mail_send and channel messages, and for invitations, meeting updates or cancellations that notify attendees.

label: Allowed recipients
help: JSON array of addresses or @domain entries, for example ["team@example.com", "@example.com"]. Every recipient and attendee must match.

label: Allowed Teams channels
help: JSON array of "<team id>/<channel id>" entries the block may post to.

label: Attachment source folder
help: Mail attachments may only be read from inside this folder (3 MiB in total). Empty refuses attachments.

label: Upload source folder
help: Local files may only be uploaded to OneDrive from inside this folder. Required for file_upload.

label: Allow deletion
help: Required for event_delete (the event goes to Deleted Items) and for replacing existing OneDrive files.

label: When an uploaded file exists
help: fail refuses the upload, rename keeps both files, replace needs Allow deletion (OneDrive keeps the previous version).

label: When the folder exists
help: reuse returns the existing folder; fail reports a conflict.

label: Watch new mail
help: Active Runtime only: polls the mail folder for new messages while the Run is loaded. One Shot uses the mail_watch operation instead.

label: Watch interval (s)
help: Time between two polls, at least 60 seconds.

label: Emit recent mail on first start
help: Off: the first start only records the current position. On: mail received in the last hours below is emitted once.

label: Recent mail window (h)
help: How far back the first start looks when Emit recent mail is on.

label: Messages per poll (max)
help: Upper bound of new messages emitted by one poll; the rest follow on the next poll.

label: Items per listing (max)
help: Upper bound for one listing; a request limit can only lower it.

label: Items per page
help: Items requested per Graph page. A page is never cut, so next_page_link resumes exactly.

label: Pages per request (max)
help: Graph pages per listing or poll; when reached, the result gives next_page_link to continue.

label: Calendar window (days)
help: Length of the events_list window when a request gives no end.

label: Time zone
help: Time zone of local event times and of returned event times, for example UTC, Europe/Paris or W. Europe Standard Time.

label: Mail body format
help: Body returned by mail_get; a request may choose the other format.

label: Mail body limit (characters)
help: Longer bodies are cut and marked truncated in the result.

label: Attachment size limit (bytes)
help: Per attachment; all attachments of one message stay within 3 MiB.

label: Upload size limit (bytes)
help: Larger files are refused before any request. Files above 4 MB use an upload session.

label: Upload chunk size (bytes)
help: Upload-session fragment size, a multiple of 327680 (320 KiB).

label: Download size limit (bytes)
help: Larger files are refused before or during the transfer; a partial file is always removed.

label: Downloads kept
help: Number of downloaded files kept in this node's storage; older downloads are deleted.

label: Operation deadline (s)
help: Total time for one operation or poll, token request, pages, transfer and retries included.

label: Retries
help: Reads retry after HTTP 429, 5xx or a lost connection; changes only after HTTP 429.

label: Longest retry wait (s)
help: A Retry-After above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting.

label: Request size limit (bytes)
help: Bound for the incoming request and each JSON body sent to Graph (sendMail with attachments: 4 MiB).

label: Response size limit (bytes)
help: Larger JSON responses are refused as protocol errors (downloads use their own limit).

label: OAuth scopes
help: Scopes sent with the refresh-token request. .default uses the delegated permissions granted to the app.

label: Graph API origin
help: Keep https://graph.microsoft.com. Another origin receives the access token; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.

label: Sign-in origin
help: Keep https://login.microsoftonline.com. Used only with a refresh-token grant; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.

label: Custom CA file
help: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
